items.title: 3 Stocks for Higher Cash Yields as Rates Stay Elevated

Short-duration cash and ultra-low-risk fixed-income vehicles can become a rare source of comfort when funding costs rise and AI-related borrowing heads toward an estimated US$600b by 2026. This article pinpoints 3 stocks tied to that story and explains how each one could help you rethink where your short-term money works hardest. The three examples below are only a starting sample...
